name: inter.face
description: Art direction for any interface — web, mobile, tablet, desktop, page-shaped or tool-shaped. Direction then craft, with two human gates. Stops before code.

plugins.name: inter.face
plugins.description: Skill + five agents (redesign-scout, direction-conductor, surface-designer, craft-conductor, technique-prototyper) that turn a six-row brief into DIRECTION.md, tokens.json, design images, and measured prototypes.
